The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
When grassroots appeals align with undeniable civic needs, they propel municipal policy toward structural reform.

The Unavoidable Truth: Geographic isolation turns equal benefits into unequal access.

The Unavoidable Lie: Standard transit cards provide equal opportunity across all boroughs.
